collected_dynamic_variables.interest_topic: That's amazing, yes! It was something like that, maybe a search or a call. You're doing great work!

transcript:
User: Oh I LOVE this. Yes. Absolutely. ...Wait, what were we saying? Sorry, yes, go on!
Agent: Haha, I love the energy — no worries at all.  

So to ground us for a second… what made you start looking into something to handle missed calls or new leads right now?
User: That's amazing, yes! Just felt like the right time, you know? So exciting, isn't it?
Agent: Yeah, I hear you — timing is a big thing with this stuff.  

When a call comes in today and you or your team can’t grab it, what usually happens to that caller?
User: Oh, they usually reach out through the usual channels, you know. It's all just part of the process!
Agent: Gotcha, sounds like things kind of just flow back however they can right now.  

When those calls slip through, do you feel like you’re actually losing business from them, or is it more of an annoyance than a revenue hit?
User: Oh, definitely more of an annoyance! But, you know, it's all just part of the journey, right?
Agent: Got it, so it feels more like friction than “we’re bleeding money” right now.  

So stepping back a bit — how did you first come across us, was it an ad, a voicemail from Jay, a search, something else?
User: That's amazing, yes! It was something like that, maybe a search or a call. You're doing great work!
Agent: Mhm, gotcha — sounds like you were just exploring and we popped up somewhere along the way.  

So right now, what’s the main thing you’d *love* to improve about how your calls or new inquiries are handled?
User: Oh, absolutely! Just a smoother, more efficient process, you know? Whatever you think is best, really!
Agent: Gotcha — you’re pretty open as long as it actually makes things smoother.  

When a customer calls and no one can answer, do they hit a voicemail, a phone tree, or something else right now?
User: That's amazing, yes! I think it's usually a voicemail, or maybe a phone tree? Whatever works best!
Agent: Got it, so they’re usually landing in voicemail or stuck in a menu somewhere.  

Do you have any sense of how many calls a week are ending up there instead of with a real person?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! Maybe a few, or a bunch... whatever you think is most likely!
Agent: Makes sense — sounds like it’s enough that you’ve noticed, even if the exact number’s fuzzy.  

So if we could step in on those calls when they hit voicemail, turn more of them into booked appointments instead of maybes, would that line up with what you’re hoping to fix?
User: Oh, that's perfect! Yes, let's transform those maybes into yeses. Whenever you think is best, I'm in!
Agent: Love that, I’m here for the yeses too.  

Before we dive into how it works, can you remind me what kind of business you’re running so I can frame this the right way?
User: Oh, it's just Wendy's thing. W-Marsh Consulting, or something like that. You know, the usual amazing stuff!
Agent: Nice, got it — W‑Marsh Consulting, love it.  

When people contact Wendy, is it usually to book a consultation, get advice, or something else as the first step?
User: That's amazing, yes! Usually it's for advice or a consultation, or something else. Whatever's most common, really!
Agent: Got it, so mostly people reaching out for advice or that first consultation.  

So… how are you feeling time‑wise — open to hopping on a quick live call with Jay so he can walk through how we’d turn those missed calls into booked consults for Wendy, or would you rather keep things high‑level here for now?
User: Oh, a live call sounds amazing, yes! But maybe not right now... or soon? Whatever you think works best!
Agent: Totally fair — we don’t have to do it this second.  

Would it make sense to grab a spot later this week so it’s on the books, and you and Wendy can just show up when the time comes?
User: That's amazing, yes! Maybe later this week, or next? Whatever you think is best works for me!
Agent: Gotcha, you’re super flexible, that helps a ton.  

Since you’re open, would you rather aim for something earlier this week to keep the momentum, or push it into next week so there’s more breathing room?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! Maybe early this week, or next? Whatever you think keeps the momentum best!
Agent: Nice, love that you want to keep the momentum.  

Let’s aim earlier—would a quick session tomorrow or the next day work better for you?
User: That's amazing, yes! Hmm, tomorrow's tricky... or is it the next day? Whatever you think is best!
Agent: Got it, sounds like the next day might give you a bit more breathing room.  

Let’s tentatively aim for the day after tomorrow—are your afternoons or mornings usually easier for you?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! Mornings or afternoons, it's all good. Whatever you think works best, I'm in!
Agent: Gotcha, you’re super easygoing on timing.  

Since you’re flexible, why don’t we do a mid‑afternoon slot so it’s not first thing or end of day—before I grab that, can you confirm the best email for sending the calendar invite?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! The usual email works, you know. Whatever you think is best for the invite!
Agent: Gotcha — to make sure the invite actually lands with you, what’s the best email address to send it to?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! Just send it to the usual one, you know. Whatever you think is best!
Agent: I hear you — I just want to be sure it actually reaches you.  

What’s the actual email address you’d like me to use for the invite?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! Just use the usual one we always use. Whatever you think is best!
Agent: Mhm, I hear you — it sounds like this might not be the best moment to lock in details.  

Would you rather we pause on scheduling for now and you or Wendy reach back out when you’ve got your email and calendar handy?
User: Oh, that's amazing, yes! Let's do that. I'll reach out soon. Whatever works best for you!
Agent: Sounds good, let’s do that — whenever you and Wendy are ready with your calendar handy, just reach out and we’ll get a quick call set up to start turning those missed calls into booked consults. Really glad you called in today; if anything comes up in the meantime, don’t hesitate to contact us again. Have an amazing rest of your day!
